comment: Three faults in the division outputs, all at Calcs.cpp:143-145, :162, :174 and :177. b/a is guarded by 'if (cValue != 0.f)' instead of aValue, so it is silenced by c rather than by a and can divide by zero when a is 0V while c is not. c/a, c/b and a/c have a guard but no else branch, so when the divisor reaches 0V the output keeps whatever it last carried; only a/b and b/c fall to 0V. Param index 0 ('Input range') is declared but never given a widget and is never read by process(); the output range is set from the panel menu, whose four choices are printed 'Unlimited', '0-10v', '± 10v' and '± 5v' at :265. The README describes a panel U/B switch clamping to 0/10V or ±5V; the installed module has no such switch and the setting lives in the menu.
